name: SC-001: Successful Login Redirects to Inventory
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the login button, and verify the Products heading is visible.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce and verify the product inventory page heading is visible.

name: SC-002: Cart Badge Updates on Add to Cart
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the cart badge shows 1.

name: SC-003: Product Name Links to Detail Page
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the product name Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the product detail page shows Sauce Labs Backpack.

name: SC-004: Sort by Price Low to High
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, select Price (low to high) from the sort dropdown, and verify the price $7.99 is visible.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, select Price (low to high) from the sort dropdown, and verify the price $7.99 is visible as the first product price.

name: SC-005: Cart Page Lists Added Items
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the cart icon, and verify the YOUR CART heading is visible on the page.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the cart icon, and verify the heading Your Cart is visible.
